probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Trendspotter Tools Categories Lists Blog Submit a tool Overview Buy Trendspotter Tools Categories Lists Blog Submit a tool Overview Buy Trendspotter Writing Penna, a writing assistant that edits in your voice Penna learns from a few pages of your own writing and suggests edits that sound like you, not like a template. Visit website Pricing Freemium Free plan included Platforms Web, macOS, Windows No public API Launched 12 March 2024 First public release Reviewed by Elin Bergqvist 15 October 2026 The review, written by Elin Bergqvist after using it for real work. Most writing assistants smooth everything into the same voice. Penna does the opposite. Give it three pages of your own writing and its suggestions start to sound like you on a good day. We used it for a month on newsletters, briefs and a long report. It caught repetition and soft verbs, and it explained every change in one line, which made it easy to say no. The free plan covers one voice and short documents. Teams will want the paid plan for shared voices and longer files. The verdict, what worked for us and what we would change.
